description: Apply one schema change (create/alter/drop table, index, view, sequence; truncate) to the app's own schema, recorded in its change log with your description. Destructive changes (drop table/column, column type change, truncate) first save a 7-day snapshot of each affected table; if the snapshot cap is reached the change is refused unless allowWithoutSnapshot. Returns { changeId, snapshots }. One statement per call.

allowWithoutSnapshot.description: Go ahead even if a safety snapshot can't be taken (cap reached). Only when the person agrees.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

description.description: What the change does and why (logged).

sql.description: Exactly one SQL statement. Use $1, $2 … for values.

name: apply_schema_change
